At Hastings Deering, our people are our heart – from their first day with us right up to their last.
As one of the top Caterpillar dealers globally and part of the Sime Darby network, you’ll have access to extensive and borderless career development opportunities and enjoy an internationally recognised work culture.
Whether you’re looking to take your career to the next level or achieve more balance in your schedule, we offer diverse opportunities for talented professionals to join our team and
start something big
.

We are looking for someone with impeccable work ethic who likes to learn, seize opportunities and take responsibility for achieving excellence whilst working as part of a great team. A successful teammate will have experience in:
Minimum three years’ experience operating Caterpillar machinery
Experience as a Trainer/Assessor considered highly advantageous

Willingness and flexibility to travel frequently to regional areas

ABOUT THE ROLE
The Assistant Manager - Internal Audit plays a critical role in supporting the Chief Internal Auditor in managing and executing the internal audit function. This includes leading audit engagements, overseeing the development of detailed program guides, and ensuring the effectiveness of internal controls.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Collaborate with the Chief Internal Auditor in developing risk-based audit plans.
Lead and conduct internal audits, focusing on the execution phase of audit engagements.
Ensure audit objectives are met and aligned with the Internal Audit Charter.
Take a lead role in preparing detailed program guides for each audit engagement, ensuring compliance with the Internal Audit Charter.
Define audit objectives, scope, and methodology within program guides.
Tailor programs based on specific risks and organizational requirements.
Engage with key stakeholders to understand business processes, risks, and control environments.
Facilitate effective communication between audit teams and management throughout the audit process.
Contribute to risk assessment processes and provide insights during audit planning.
Assist in assessing and analysing organizational risks, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
Support the Chief Internal Auditor in preparing and presenting comprehensive audit reports.
Ensure that audit reports are clear, concise, and aligned with established standards.
Collaborate with the Chief Internal Auditor to implement and maintain internal audit standards and methodologies.
Participate in quality assurance processes to enhance the effectiveness of the internal audit function.
Lead audit teams during the execution phase, providing guidance and support.
Contribute to the development and mentoring of audit team members.
REQUIREMENTS
A bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or a related field is typically required, or equivalent certification in auditing, accounting, or finance is highly preferred
Minimum of over 5 years in the field of internal auditing, external auditing, or a related area, ideally in the Banking and finance Industry.
Experience conducting various types of audits, including financial, operational, and compliance audits is an advantage Proficiency in accounting systems and Microsoft Excel.
Experience conducting various types of audits, including financial, operational, and compliance audits is an advantage.
Strong critical and problem-solving skills necessary to assess risks and control deficiencies.
Ability to explain technical concepts in a clear and concise manner is highly valued.

26421.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Responsible for operating the Jumbo in a safe and appropriate manner to carry out earth moving task as directed by the shift supervisor for general operations.
Key / Major Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Safely operate Jumbo Drill as part of underground work plan pre task jobs.
Assure working area is safe for men and equipment to perform working duties. This includes but is not limited to: check scaling, ensuring electrical installations and services are clear of drilling area, erecting barricades with signs where appropriate, and guarding against injury or damage when holes breakthrough.
Drill holes to design line, gradient and profile.
Perform daily safety prestart maintenance checks.
Clean Jumbo as scheduled and/or required.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you must have 3 or more years' experience as Jumbo operator and have experience in operating Sandvik DD421 and DD422i. In addition to this, you will have some or all the following.
Possess current Class 7 driver’s license.
Must have at least 5 or more years of Jumbo Twin Boom Operation
Must have Underground Mining experience.
Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.
Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.
Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

Head of Finance and Operations
The Head of Finance and Operations has responsibility for leading and managing the finance, administration and HR functions of ChildFund PNG.
The role is a key member of the Senior Management Team and will work closely with the Country director and Programs team to ensure strong program impact.
Key Responsibilities
Responsible for leading and managing the finance team in the provision of high quality internal and external financial reporting.
Manage the timely preparation of annual/long term budgets and detailed expenditure plans including departmental budgets to support project oversight
Ensuring appropriate financial and internal controls including delegations of authority are in place and adhered to.
Ensure that all project audits as requested by donors are carried out judiciously and documented evidence are provided as necessary.

Significant experience and knowledge of Financial Management

Strong problem solving and analytical skills
Excellent computer and typing skills (including Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

26337.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
In this role, you will manage the effective and safe operation of the K92 processing plant, Tailings Storage Facility and Processing Services operations (incorporating tails filter plant, binder plant, batch plant and mobile crushing operations) and workforce for the efficient operation of the facility. The role will oversee coordination of the processing team in all aspects of the processing functions and operations to meet scheduled production targets and provide technical and operational support to Manager - Processing
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Develop a reporting framework to allow effective communication and dissemination of process plant safety, environment, production, and cost data throughout processing teams.
Supervision and management of all process operations staff and contractors.
Management all operational aspects and functions of the process plant.
Mentor site metallurgical team.
Drive metallurgical test work and optimisation projects.
Oversee accuracy and reliability of metallurgical accounting systems.
Liaise with fixed plant maintenance superintendents to develop strategies to achieve budget equipment availability and desired performance.
Develop and implement programs to improve supervisors and operators’ skill levels and identify training and development needs.
Manage capital and operating budgets within the process department.
Ensure all production targets are achieved in a safe and timely manner and with under budget cost.
Plan, manage, and evaluate staff performance.
Establishes performance requirements and personal development targets for assigned staff; regularly monitor performance and provide coaching for performance improvement and development.
Recommend compensation and provide other rewards to recognise performance.
Where required, ensure disciplinary action to address performance deficiencies, in accordance with the Company’s rules and policies.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you
Bachelor’s Degree in Metallurgy, Mineral Processing or Chemical Engineering
Minimum of (10) years’ experience in a Mineral Processing Plant
Expert level MS Excel skills
PNG Mine Manager Works Certificate of Competency
Class three (3) driver’s license
Sulphide Mineral Floatation experience, crushing and grinding experience.
Sound knowledge of mining industry safety, environmental and operational practices.
Sound knowledge of mill control systems (SCADA)
Ability to diagnose faults with equipment and processes within the Operations area.
Able to lead, provide training and coaching to staff within the processing department.
Strong planning and analytical skills.
A team player with good computer skills.
Able to communicate effectively across all levels.
Ability to train process plant personnel in all aspects of their trade – particularly in diagnosis and fault finding, quality control, thoroughness and record keeping.
Must be a self-starter, and very resourceful, with the ability to find solutions to problems to ensure the equipment availability is high.
Good health physical ability is a prerequisite, as is the ability to live in a remote environment with limited facilities. Flexible, adaptable and be a team player.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

26624.description:
About Newmont
At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.
About Lihir
Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.
Your Impact
In this opportunity, we are looking for a young local Lihirian, who is keen, determined and is passionate to build career in Health & Safety. You will be introduced to the foundations of a safe and healthy workplace by learning directly from experienced Health & Safety Advisors and supporting frontline teams to identify, manage, and eliminate safety risks helping protect people from fatalities, injuries, illness and work-related harm.
As part of our team, you will
Participate in field inspections and safety audits to identify hazards and support compliance with safety standards and regulations.
Support the delivery of hands‑on safety coaching and training for site personnel, including pre‑task hazard assessments, general risk assessments, event reporting, and 5‑Why investigations.
Observe and reinforce site‑specific safety procedures, ensuring teams understand and follow established protocols.
Contribute to key safety programs such as fatal risk management, incident management, injury reduction, and health and wellbeing initiatives by applying field observations and feedback.
Assist in the execution of site‑based Health & Safety plans.
Support the Health & Safety Representative (HSR) program and promote a culture of speaking up and stopping unsafe work.
Actively contribute as a team member by asking questions, seeking feedback, sharing improvement ideas, and continuously learning.
Prerequisites for your success in this role
To thrive in this position, you will bring:
Experience in a School to Mine or similar early‑career development program.
The ability to follow procedures, apply practical judgement, and seek guidance when required.
A developing problem‑solving mindset, with the ability to learn through observation, experience, and trial and error.
Basic computer skills to support reporting and documentation.
Strong self‑awareness, adaptability, and a willingness to learn from feedback.
The ability to collaborate effectively with a diverse range of stakeholders and work productively within a team environment.
Drive, determination, and commitment to delivering high‑quality work aligned with Newmont’s values and safety culture.
Your work environment
This is a two year fixed term, full time position, operating Monday to Friday, with camp accommodation provided. Our employees stay in a secure and comfortable camp, in an en-suited and airconditioned room equipped with mini fridge, TV and Wi-Fi. A variety of healthy meal options are catered for at our mess; and the wet mess provides a relaxed social setting where employees can unwind with a game of pool or darts.
You will work closely with operational supervisors, superintendents, Health & Safety peers, site representatives, and reporting teams across the business. This is a practical, site‑based role that offers exposure to real‑world safety challenges, supported by experienced professionals who are committed to your development and success.
Why Join Newmont
At Newmont, safety is our first value. We offer meaningful early‑career opportunities where you can learn, grow, and make a genuine impact from day one. You’ll be supported by experienced leaders, exposed to industry‑leading safety practices, and empowered to contribute to a culture where everyone is accountable for keeping themselves and others safe.
At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry.
We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond. We know no candidate meets every qualification listed, so if you share our values and feel you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply – we’d love to hear from you!
Submit your application through our website quoting reference number 41769 before the advertised closing date: 13th April 2026.
Apply

26492.description:
Job Title:
Transport Scheduler
Department:
Transport - Main Operations
Reports To:
Transport Manager
Direct Reports:
Transport Coordinators / Drivers
Location:
Port Moresby
Role Purpose
The Transport Scheduler is responsible for the planning of daily transport jobs, including fleet and driver allocations, leading the day-to-day execution of the transport operations, ensuring service reliability, safety compliance, fleet efficiency, and team performance.
Key Responsibilities
Operational Leadership
Lead daily pre-start briefings and end-of-shift debriefs.
Ensure coordinators execute the daily transport plan and follow SOPs.
Communicate the daily transport plan, oversee timely fleet dispatch, including run sheets and accompanying delivery dockets.
Distribute regular progress reporting.
Plan backloads, resolve delays and disruptions, and communicate any adjustments and additional jobs to the daily transport plan.
People Leadership
Supervise and coach coordinators and drivers.
Oversee rosters, breaks, and attendance.
Address behaviour and performance issues fairly.
Safety, Compliance & Risk
Manage driver fatigue, licensing, and fleet assignment compliance.
Verify pre-starts, defects, and equipment readiness.
Respond to breakdowns, accidents, and weather issues.
Lead incident reporting and investigations.
Check weights, dimensions, load restraints, fleet – load suitability and site requirements.
Customer & Stakeholder Management
Act as escalation point for customer transport operational issues.
Communicate delays, and recovery plans.
Collaborate with transport coordinators, drivers, transport administrators and port wharf teams, customs and freight forwarding, HSE and compliance, workshop teams and port terminals / wharfs.
Performance, Reporting & Continuous Improvement
Drive KPIs including OTD, utilisation, and data quality.
Identify root causes and drive improvement actions.
Ensure accurate data entry by transport coordinators.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Gate-out time, On-Time Delivery and schedule adherence.
Fleet utilization (trips per day) and empty kilometer reduction.
Overtime control and additional charges (detention).
Customer complaint rate.
Safety compliance and driver adherence to safety protocols.
Data accuracy and timely submission daily (Runsheets, PODs / EIR’s, delivery dockets and accompanying incvoices)
Incident rate and close-out timeliness.
Team performance and coaching outcomes.
Skills & Competencies
Technical Skills
Knowledge of scheduling, routing and dispatching.
Proficiency with telematics systems.
Understanding of fatigue, mass, and load restraint rules.
Ability to interpret and act on KPIs.
Behavioural Skills
Good leadership, collaborative and good clear communication.
Calm under pressure, decisive, detail focus, disciplined and organized.
High integrity and safety focus.
Pro-active, problem-solver with strong accountability and customer service-delivery focus.
Qualifications & Experience
3 - 5 years in transport operations.
1 - 2 years supervisory experience.
Knowledge of local road transport network and customer sites.
Certificate/Diploma in Transport, Logistics or Business advantageous.
Working Conditions
Fast-paced operational environment.
Early/late hours, weekend and public holiday work as required.
Office and yard interaction, driver briefings and occasional site visits.
This position is available for immediate start. If this sounds like you, please submit your application to
[email protected]
;
[email protected]
Please note that ONLY shortlisted candidate will be contacted for interview.
Do not apply if you dont meet above requiremetns as those applicants will be ignored.
Apply

26312.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our maintenance team on site, in this role you will be responsible for assisting in the rigging and lifting operations within an industrial mining environment. This role involves the safe and efficient handling of loads, ensuring compliance with safety regulations and industry standards.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Ensuring that the sections daily work plans are executed as directed.
Assist in the setup and dismantling of rigging equipment, including hoists, cranes, and other lifting devices.
Work with various rigging gear such as slings, ropes, and chains to secure loads for lifting and moving.
Assist Supervisor develop Safe Lifting Plan and assessments
Identify load centre of gravity and determine appropriate rigging configurations.
Adhere to all safety protocols and procedures, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
Conduct pre-lift inspections of rigging equipment and report any defects or concerns to supervisors.
Participate in risk assessments, JSAs, and toolbox meetings.
Maintain work areas in a clean and safe condition.
Stop unsafe work and report hazards or incidents immediately.
Assist in the movement of materials and equipment in a safe and efficient manner.
Interpret lift plans, load charts, and site drawings.
Assist crane operators and signal lifts using approved hand signals or radio communication.
Ensure barricades and exclusion zones are in place during lifting operations.
Maintain clear communication with team members and equipment operators during rigging operations.
Report any incidents or near misses to ensure continuous improvement in safety practices.
Complete necessary paperwork related to rigging operations, including equipment inspection logs and work permits.
Maintain an organized work area and ensure that rigging equipment is stored properly after use
Strong understanding of rigging principles and load control.
Ability to read drawings and lift plans.
Excellent situational awareness and safety focus.
Clear communication and teamwork.
Problem-solving during complex lifts.
Ability to work at heights and in varied weather conditions.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you have all or some of the following
Minimum Grade eight educational qualification, but preferably a Grade ten certificate or PETT courses.
Current Basic Rigging License (or equivalent certification).
Understanding of rigging principles and safe lifting practices.
Working at Heights certification.
Ability to work in a team environment and follow directions from supervisors.
Strong communication skills and the ability to remain calm under pressure.
Demonstrated experience in a similar role preferably in the construction, heavy Engineering or Mining industry
Physically fit and able to perform manual work, including lifting heavy loads.
Ability to read and write both Pidgin and English
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply
